faqs.question: What is the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 Single Channel Peristaltic Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 handles both precise reagent dosing and fast bulk fluid transfer, making it suited to reactor feed-batch dosing, chemostat operation, and rapid tank filling and emptying.

faqs.question: What flow rate does the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 deliver?
faqs.answer: In single-channel operation the pump delivers 2.0 to 4,056 mL/min, with the exact figure depending on the tubing bore fitted and the speed setting used.

faqs.question: How accurate is the dosing on the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600?
faqs.answer: Control accuracy is ±0.5% with a precision of ±2%, and the retraction function further protects accuracy at small dosed volumes by preventing a drop from forming at the tube tip.

faqs.question: What is the retraction function?
faqs.answer: After each pumping run, the drive briefly reverses to pull the tube back and clear the last drop at the tip, which keeps microlitre-scale dosing accurate rather than letting a hanging drop register as an error.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 be automated?
faqs.answer: Yes. RS232 and analogue interfaces, 0 to 10 V or 4 to 20 mA, put speed, direction, and start and stop under external control from a PLC or process system.

faqs.question: Does the pump include the pump head and tubing?
faqs.answer: No. The pump drive is supplied on its own; the pump head and tubing are selected separately to match your flow rate and fluid chemistry, and Inkarp confirms this configuration before quotation.

faqs.question: What is interval dosing?
faqs.answer: Interval dosing lets you set a dosing volume together with a pause time, from 0.1 seconds to 750 hours, so a multi-step dosing sequence runs unattended exactly as programmed.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 and Ultimate 120?
faqs.answer: Both carry the same dosing accuracy, interval dosing, retraction function, and interfaces. The difference is the top-end speed: 600 rpm against a 120 rpm ceiling, which sets the maximum flow rate each variant reaches.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 run continuously?
faqs.answer: Yes. The pump is rated for continuous 24/7 operation, suited to chemostat feed and other processes that cannot pause.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600?
faqs.answer: The part number is 523-52060-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this configuration in India.

sections.title: Flow Rate and Dosing Accuracy
sections.tabSummary: What ±0.5% control accuracy delivers at your tubing size
body: The number on the datasheet is a range; the number that matters is what your specific tubing bore delivers at your specific speed setting. Flow rate on a peristaltic pump is a function of speed and tubing internal diameter together, not speed alone.

At the low end of the 24 to 600 rpm range, a fine-bore tube delivers microlitre-scale dosing with room to spare. At 600 rpm with a wide-bore tube, the same drive moves toward its 4,056 mL/min ceiling for fast fill and empty work. The ±0.5% control accuracy holds the drive steady at whichever point on that curve the application sits, and the ±2% precision figure describes how tightly repeat doses land relative to each other.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi Channel Peristaltic Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Expert 120 Multi is used for multi-channel dispensing and fast fluid transfer, with one drive taking either a single-channel or multi-channel head and an analogue interface for external control.

faqs.question: Can the same pump run both single-channel and multi-channel heads?
faqs.answer: Yes. The drive accepts either configuration, so one instrument covers both single-channel and multi-channel work.

faqs.question: What is the turbo button on the Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: The turbo button takes the drive to full speed with one press, useful for draining a tube or clearing residue quickly, on either head configuration.

faqs.question: What flow rate does the Expert 120 Multi deliver?
faqs.answer: Single-channel flow runs 0.5 to 936 mL/min. Multi-channel flow runs 0.005 to 277 mL/min per channel, depending on the head fitted.

faqs.question: Does the Expert 120 Multi support programmed dosing?
faqs.answer: No. Volume dosing, interval dosing, and RS232 connectivity are not available on this model. For programmed dosing, the Hei-FLOW Ultimate range carries that functionality.

faqs.question: How is the Expert 120 Multi controlled?
faqs.answer: Through a single analogue interface, 0–10 V or 4–20 mA, which sets speed, direction, and start/stop.

faqs.question: Does the pump include the pump head and tubing?
faqs.answer: No. The pump drive is supplied on its own; the pump head and tubing are selected separately based on your channel configuration and fluid, and Inkarp confirms this before quotation.

faqs.question: What is the precision of the Expert 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: Precision is ±3.5%, with a control accuracy of ±0.5% at the drive.

faqs.question: What other variants are available?
faqs.answer: The same drive is also available as the Expert 600, capped at 600 rpm and single-channel only, and as a Standard version limited to single-channel operation at this speed cap.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-FLOW Expert 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: The part number is 523-51013-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this configuration in India.

faqs.answer: The price depends on the pump head, tubing, and channel configuration your application needs. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your flow requirements are confirmed.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi Channel Peristaltic Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Ultimate 120 Multi is used for precision dosing in pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food-grade processes, with ±1% precision and the flexibility to run single-channel or multi-channel pump heads.

faqs.question: What makes this the most precise pump in the Hei-FLOW range?
faqs.answer: Its ±1% precision is the tightest across the range, tighter than the Ultimate 600's ±2%, a result of its lower, more tightly controllable 5 to 120 rpm speed range.

faqs.question: Can the Ultimate 120 Multi run both single-channel and multi-channel heads?
faqs.answer: Yes. The drive accepts either configuration, so one instrument covers precise dosing on a single flow or across several parallel channels.

faqs.question: What is the retraction function?
faqs.answer: After each pumping run, the drive briefly reverses to pull the tube back and clear the last drop at the tip, protecting accuracy at the smallest dosed volumes.

faqs.question: Can the pump be operated inside a closed exhaust hood?
faqs.answer: Yes. The optional foot switch lets you start and stop the pump from outside a closed exhaust hood, so hazardous or sensitive media can be handled without reaching into the enclosure.

faqs.question: Can the Ultimate 120 Multi be automated?
faqs.answer: Yes. RS232 and analogue interfaces, 0–10 V or 4–20 mA, put speed, direction, and start/stop under external control from a PLC or process system.

faqs.question: What is interval dosing?
faqs.answer: A programmable dosing volume paired with a pause time, from 0.1 seconds to 750 hours, so a multi-step dosing sequence runs unattended exactly as specified.

faqs.question: Does the pump include the pump head and tubing?
faqs.answer: No. The pump drive is supplied on its own; the pump head and tubing are selected separately to match your channel configuration and fluid, and Inkarp confirms this before quotation.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Ultimate 120 Multi and the Ultimate 600?
faqs.answer: Both offer full dosing automation, retraction, and RS232 connectivity. The Ultimate 120 Multi adds channel flexibility and reaches tighter ±1% precision, while the Ultimate 600 covers a higher 24 to 600 rpm speed range for faster conveying, single-channel only.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 120 Multi?
faqs.answer: The part number is 523-52013-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this configuration in India.

faqs.answer: The price depends on the pump head, tubing, and accessories your application needs. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your precision and channel requirements are confirmed.

sections.title: Channel Flow and Dosing Precision
sections.tabSummary: What ±1% precision means per channel configuration
body: Precision here means two things at once: how tightly the drive holds a set speed, and how tightly repeat doses land against each other. This pump is rated ±0.5% on the first and ±1% on the second both tighter than the equivalent 600 rpm Ultimate.

Channel configuration changes what that precision applies to. A single-channel head puts the full 0.36 to 813 mL/min range and the full ±1% precision behind one flow. A multi-channel head splits the drive across several channels, each running 0.005 to 329 mL/min at the same precision, which is what makes parallel, validated dosing across multiple lines possible from one instrument.
